title: Save four ADDs in an actual BIT shared-source packet
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

An exact factorization of one actual R438 shared-source prelude reduces 13 ADDs to 9: the complete frozen word uses **36,001 instead of 36,005 ADDs**, with its 2,913-query histogram, rank mass 5,101 and nine COPY/ERASE episodes unchanged. The original cleanup, arbitrary dirty-input behavior and finite prefix bounds are preserved.

The same packet exposes a precise limit on source-only query sharing. Its two helper rows contain independent dirt, and the unchanged public suffix separately needs both streams. Source-only excursions cannot supply their missing dirty transforms; the displayed exact repair adds **four rank-two queries**. Noncommutation here refers to the address projectors, whose commutator has entry 1/8; the original sites act on distinct registers.

This is a scalar construction and scoped interface audit. It is not a universal noncommuting lower bound, optimal-repair theorem, native supplier admission, recursive-moment improvement or new κ. Public behavior is Boolean; the stronger integer source/helper restoration is checked separately, preserving the inherited even dirty-target terms.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Publication head: `8cbaba3416505afb8249c95884bf33698a01eb9d`.

The user-assigned actual-site mechanism audit has **changed** scope relative to the pinned `bit-new-register-model` card. Only `research/bit-shared-source-compensation/` is added. Its [README](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cbaba3416505afb8249c95884bf33698a01eb9d/research/bit-shared-source-compensation/README.md), TASK and source notes state the bounded question and stop rule.

- [#4021](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4021), head `c01f97ecfc7fa64847f6abd8f7b231e1df8c7b70`, supplies the byte-identical WORD and GEOMETRY archives. They are bundled, so this replay needs no predecessor checkout.
- Hanson Sun’s [#1522](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1522) already supplies restored source tours for additive outputs. This package audits actual helper inputs whose independent dirt must also be transformed; it does not refute that earlier construction or claim the generic tour idea.
- Chris R / Clear1nsight’s [#4005](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4005) concerns a different R437 node509 carrier-deletion quotient. The new evidence here is the pinned R438 original-site/suffix audit, scalar factorization and complete repair invoice.

Fresh overlap covered 760 open PR records, 2,602 Discussion records and 4,124 local records. Coverage and limits are retained in `OVERLAP.json`; this is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-shared-source-compensation
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-shared-source-compensation --check-source-history
```

- Registered normal and optimized Python 3.12.12 replay passes; only this package is selected for replay.
- Separate implementation checks all 660 input columns, actual frame projectors, delivery cuts, COPY/ERASE guards, both literal inverse orders, complete invoices and meaningful defect controls.
- All five mathematical checker sources, recipes and expected mathematical receipts are unchanged from the independently reviewed local result. Public predecessor archives match their pinned Git blobs byte for byte.
- Committed-byte/source-history and official export integrity checks pass. The read-only Git-free export reproduces the same complete semantic receipts under `-O`. Changed-source and repinned-false-receipt controls reject as intended.

Hosted [Registered research packages CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39251849184) passed on this exact publication head, including both registered commands and the unchanged-input check. No selected-frontier cold replay, physical tape/compiler execution, all-size closure, independent human review or formal-kernel proof is claimed.

Retain Ali Romman’s R438/#1043, Sagar Thakrar’s transported word and hosting lineage, cheesegrader’s #540 framework, #589/#1023 hosting, and the controller contributors named in `SOURCE-NOTES.md`. Credit Hanson Sun/#1522, Ross Richardson/#953, Wentao Li/#840 and Chris R/#4005 for the related prior mechanisms and boundaries. New work by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI mathematical and implementation review. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The [package’s next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cbaba3416505afb8249c95884bf33698a01eb9d/research/bit-shared-source-compensation/README.md#open-next-questions) require either a legal paid word jointly processing the independent helper dirt or an actual changed consumer that retires a residual demand. Each needs complete access, restoration, delivery and owner costs before further expansion; neither is supplied here.
